Resolves #21632

Adds `examples/board/columns` (`Atelier Nord · Commissions`), a 20-commission studio board across six stages (`Enquiry`, `Quote`, `In work`, `Review`, `Archive` folded at the start, and `Delivered` locked at index 5). Unlocked headers reorder via `Neo.board.ColumnSortZone` while `Delivered` keeps its final slot, every column folds and opens by click or keyboard (`Enter` and `Space` when `.neo-board-column-collapse` holds focus), a live stage-order bar writes the current sequence as text (`Enquiry → Quote → In work → Review → Archive → Delivered`), and the styled `↺ Reset arrangement` pill restores the initial order, folded `Archive` strip, and card placements.

Evidence: L3 (Playwright E2E + headless Chrome 1x/2x rendered frames across 5 themes at 1440×900 and 390×844) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-8). Residual: none.

## Cold look
Two blind `research` readers without session context graded unlabelled `cand-m` (`board/basic`) and `cand-n` (`board/columns`) at `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844` in swapped order:
- **Reader A (order `M → N`):** Candidate M `6.5 / 10`, Candidate N **`9.0 / 10`** (`N > M`) — cited 3-tier commission card hierarchy, zero vertical mid-card clipping, explicit `⋮⋮` drag grips (omitted on locked `Delivered`), vertical `Archive (3)` strip, live `STAGE ORDER` bar, and styled `↺ Reset arrangement` pill.
- **Reader B (order `N → M`):** Candidate N **`8.5 / 10`**, Candidate M `5.5 / 10` (`N > M`) — cited cohesive desktop proportions across all six stages, clear drag/fold/lock affordances, and responsive two-row mobile header vs M's split-screen mid-card clipping.

Frame critique: At `1440 × 900`, all six stages (`Enquiry`, `Quote`, `In work`, `Review`, folded `Archive`, and locked `Delivered`) fit across the viewport with zero mid-card truncation. Both cold readers noted three intentional trade-offs kept as designed: (1) on `390 × 844`, the subtitle and status pill hide so the header + `STAGE ORDER` readout stay compact while `Quote` peeks at the right edge to cue horizontal board scrolling (shared `.neo-board` horizontal scroll behavior); (2) `Enquiry` uses slate `#64748b` for its top bar, which sits quieter against `neo-dark` than the brighter active stages (`Quote`..`Delivered`); and (3) one lead commission per stage carries `CardModel#color` left-edge accent to exercise the engine's per-card accent slot alongside column accents.
